bugs_found.title: --version and --help require config to exist
bugs_found.description: Both --version and --help flags are gated behind check_config_exists(). New users can't see version or help without first running wikigen init.
bugs_found.expected: wikigen --version should always work regardless of config state
bugs_found.actual: Exits with code 1 and prints 'WikiGen is not configured yet. Please run wikigen init'

bugs_found.title: Error conditions exit with code 0
bugs_found.description: Invalid path, empty directory, and other error conditions all return exit code 0 instead of a non-zero code.
bugs_found.expected: Non-zero exit codes for all error conditions (important for CI/scripting use)
bugs_found.actual: Exit code 0 even on errors like 'Directory does not exist'

bugs_found.title: Invalid config keys accepted without validation
bugs_found.description: wikigen config set accepts any arbitrary key name and persists it to config.json without validating against known keys.
bugs_found.expected: Should reject unknown config keys with an error message
bugs_found.actual: Silently writes nonexistent_key to config file

bugs_found.title: Keyring warning on every invocation
bugs_found.description: A verbose keyring backend warning is printed to stderr on every single command invocation on Linux systems without a desktop keyring.
bugs_found.expected: Warn once or suppress in non-interactive/CI mode
bugs_found.actual: Warning printed 3-5 times per command invocation

summary: WikiGen 1.1.0 installs cleanly and the core app launches, renders correctly, and handles directory crawling and GitHub URL detection. All features that do not require an LLM API key work. 4 bugs identified (1 high, 2 medium, 1 low). LLM-dependent wiki generation could not be fully tested due to missing API key.
